description: This script automates documentation generation, packaging, and release processes for a software project, including running doxygen, building PDFs, and creating release archives.

methods.name: docs_gen_all
methods.description: Generates documentation and optionally builds a release package based on the build_release flag.

methods.name: launch_html
methods.description: Opens the generated HTML documentation in Firefox.

methods.name: build_pdf
methods.description: Builds a PDF version of the documentation using pdflatex.

methods.name: package_release
methods.description: Creates a release package including HTML, PDF, and header files, then archives it.
